LanguageData.JustStart_ButtonJustStartTooltip: Generate the world, then skip straight to playing: pick a random starting site, set up the ideoligion and accept the scenario's colonists (with the xenotype chosen in the settings), with no further setup screens.\n\nRight-click for Just Start settings.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsExcludeExtremeTooltip: Never start in a biome the game warns about when you settle there:\n{0}
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsDefaultIdeologyTooltip: How Just Start sets up your ideoligion.
LanguageData.JustStart_IdeologyModeInactive: Classic ideoligion for the player only
LanguageData.JustStart_IdeologyModeClassic: Classic mode (every faction shares one classic ideoligion)
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsXenotypeTooltip: The xenotype of every starting colonist, or a random one each with Mixed. Anything other than Scenario's choice overrides the xenotypes the scenario sets.
LanguageData.JustStart_XenotypeScenarioTooltip: Starting colonists keep the xenotypes the scenario gives them, such as the sanguophage in The Sanguophage.
LanguageData.JustStart_XenotypeMixedTooltip: Each starting colonist gets a random xenotype from every xenotype loaded.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsMixedCustomTooltip: Mixed can also pick the custom xenotypes you have saved in the xenotype editor.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsMixedCustomRequiresMix: Only used when the starting xenotype is Mixed.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsLimitAgeTooltip: Adult starting colonists are generated with a biological age in the range below. Ages within the range follow the game's usual age distribution. Children and babies a scenario asks for are not affected.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsAgeRangeRequiresLimit: Only used when Limit starting age is on.
LanguageData.JustStart_SettingsCapableTooltip: Adult starting colonists are generated with no disabled work, from backstories, traits, genes or health. If a forced xenotype or the scenario makes that impossible, the colonist is accepted after repeated tries. Children, babies and mutants a scenario asks for are not affected.
LanguageData.JustStart_ErrorNoValidTile: No valid starting site exists on this world.
LanguageData.JustStart_ErrorNoStartingPawns: This scenario produced no starting colonists.
LanguageData.JustStart_ErrorAdjustWorld: The game has not been started. Adjust the world settings and try again.
